title: ribes uva-crispa subsp. glandulososetosum
intro: Ribes uva-crispa subsp. glandulososetosum, commonly known as a type of gooseberry, is a plant species belonging to the Grossulariaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including gastrointestinal problems, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ribes uva-crispa subsp. glandulososetosum include its ability to soothe digestive issues and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
